title: Cracked lake ice with bubbles and skate scratches
purpose: Generate tileable maps of frozen lake ice: clear black or milky ice with white fracture planes, a polygonal crack network, trapped air bubbles, stacked methane bubbles and skate scratches. Use for frozen lakes, rinks, ice caves and winter ground.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python lake_ice_cracked.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: fractures
parameters.meaning: Long fracture lines wandering across the tile.

parameters.name: network
parameters.meaning: Polygonal network of thin cracks between ice plates.

parameters.name: plates
parameters.meaning: Plates across the tile for the crack network.

parameters.name: pancakes
parameters.meaning: Stacks of flat white methane bubbles.

parameters.name: scratches
parameters.meaning: Skate scratches cut into the surface.

parameters.name: milkiness
parameters.meaning: Share of white, cloudy snow ice against clear black ice.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Black ice: clear dark ice with white fracture planes and scattered bubbles.

presets.name: methane_bubbles
presets.description: Clear ice full of stacked white methane bubbles, few cracks.

presets.name: skating_rink
presets.description: Milky outdoor rink ice criss-crossed by skate scratches.

presets.name: pressure_cracked
presets.description: Blue ice broken into plates by a dense crack network and fractures.

limits: Cracks and bubbles inside the ice are painted into the albedo, not modelled in depth, so there is no parallax or refraction through clear ice; a shader that wants depth can use the albedo as a view-independent layer under a glossy surface. Fracture planes are a bright line with a fainter offset sheet, a stylized reading of slanted cracks. The crack network is a Worley diagram broken by noise. Bubbles smaller than about half a pixel at the output size are left out. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Jagged random-walk polylines with wrap-around capsule painting
Offset translucent sheet beside each crack for a slanted fracture plane
Worley cell borders broken by fractal noise for a crack network
Jittered grid placement and ring stamps for bubbles
Stacked soft discs for methane bubbles
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
